description: Narrow linear IV/2SLS estimator with auditable diagnostics. Explicitly distinguishes: structural equation / outcome, endogenous regressor(s), excluded instrument(s), included exogenous controls, fixed effects (if exercised), clustering/covariance convention, sample, first stage, reduced form (where available), and the second-stage 2SLS estimate. Does NOT machine-verify the exclusion restriction and does NOT interpret relevance diagnostics as proof of instrument validity. Director/human scientific decisions are required for instrument definition, endogenous-regressor definition, exclusion-restriction argument, clustering, sample exclusions, and model/specification choice.

references.name: Stock & Yogo (2005) - Testing for weak instruments (Cragg-Donald / weak-ID critical values; cited by ivreg2)
Staiger & Stock (1997) - Instrumental variables regression with weak instruments

methodology.note: IV/2SLS is a narrow estimator; validity rests on the exclusion restriction + relevance + exogeneity, which are human/Director scientific judgments. Weak-instrument and diagnostic statistics are NOT interchangeable: conventional first-stage F, partial F, Kleibergen-Paap rk Wald F, Cragg-Donald Wald F, Sanderson-Windmeijer conditional F, Anderson-Rubin / Stock-Wright weak-IV-robust inference, and underidentification (Anderson canonical corr. LM) each have distinct definitions and are produced by different engines. Only definition-compatible quantities are compared across engines; tool-specific statistics are documented, not forced to equality. Relevance diagnostics (e.g. first-stage F) are evidence of relevance, NOT of instrument validity.

verification.evidence: Tested for the exact demonstrated scope: homoskedastic (unadjusted) IV/2SLS on the Card (1993) NLSYM returns-to-schooling benchmark (lwage ~ exper expersq black smsa south + [educ ~ nearc4], N=3010, dataset checksum d6afc7e7...). Evidence: genuine real-data benchmark (linearmodels.dexport datasets.card), source fidelity (coefficients/SE/N from actual IV2SLS output), deterministic artifact mapping (model_registry/estimates/diagnostics/replication_stamp/artifact_manifest validate), provenance enforcement, and cross-engine agreement with statreg2 (educ coef 0.1322887693, SE 0.0491759499, N=3010). Scope note: the tested claim is the 2SLS coefficient/SE/N for this spec; weak-instrument/underid/weak-IV-robust diagnostics are NOT part of the tested claim (linearmodels default summary does not expose Kleibergen-Paap / Sanderson-Windmeijer / Anderson-Rubin in this version; they are documented as tool-specific, not fabricated). NOT verified; NOT a claim of general IV validity.

Evidence: genuine real-data benchmark, source fidelity (educ coef 0.1322887693, SE 0.0491759499, N=3010 match linearmodels under homoskedastic 2SLS), and ivreg2-native diagnostics captured with explicit method identity (Anderson canon. corr.
